subject: Prefer a source-verified SEC primary document over its duplicate filing index representation

regression.previous_behavior: ScoutIndex emitted both filing_index and filing_document for one issuer/accession, causing duplicate downstream governance filings.
regression.fixed_behavior: The source-verified primary document is emitted once; the index finding remains retained in the immutable analysis snapshot.

validation.focused_command: python -m unittest tests.test_sec_document_scout tests.test_sec_scout_service tests.test_governance_event_agent tests.test_scout_store

initial_clean_host_attempt.reason: Declared project dependencies were not installed; the failed attempt is not counted as a pass.
